candidates.name: Keeper Security, Inc.
candidates.description: Provides a comprehensive platform for enterprise password management, secrets management, and privileged access security.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise password, secrets, and access-security platforms evaluated by IT and security teams for credential protection.

candidates.name: Bitwarden Inc.
candidates.description: Offers an open-source password management solution that enables teams and enterprises to store and share credentials securely.
candidates.rationale: Both provide business password management and secure credential sharing for teams and enterprises, serving the same security buyers and users.

candidates.name: Dashlane
candidates.description: Delivers a robust password management and credential protection platform designed for both individual users and business environments.
candidates.rationale: Dashlane directly overlaps 1Password in business password management and credential security, serving the same organizational buyers and users.

candidates.name: LastPass
candidates.description: Focuses on password vaulting, multi-factor authentication, and single sign-on services for individual and corporate users.
candidates.rationale: LastPass directly overlaps 1Password in business password management, access security, MFA, and SSO for employees and corporate IT buyers.

candidates.name: NordPass Enterprise
candidates.description: Offers business and personal password management tools including secure credential storage and automated form filling.
candidates.rationale: NordPass Enterprise directly overlaps 1Password in business credential storage and password management for employees and IT/security buyers.

candidates.name: Enpass Technologies Inc.
candidates.description: Provides a password manager that allows users to maintain control over their data by storing vaults on their own cloud infrastructure.
candidates.rationale: Enpass offers password management with user-controlled vault storage, directly overlapping 1Password’s core credential-management use case and target users.

candidates.name: Roboform
candidates.description: Specializes in password management and automated form-filling technology for both consumer and enterprise productivity.
candidates.rationale: RoboForm offers business password management and credential security, serving the same enterprise users and access-management job as 1Password.

candidates.name: Passbolt SA
candidates.description: Provides an open-source password management platform specifically engineered for team collaboration and secure credential sharing.
candidates.rationale: Both provide business-focused password management and secure credential sharing for teams, serving the same access-security buyers and use case.

candidates.name: Senhasegura
candidates.description: Functions as an identity security platform focused on the secure storage and management of high-privilege credentials.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise credential security and management, with overlap in privileged-access protection and security/IT buyers.

candidates.name: Delinea Inc.
candidates.description: Offers advanced privileged access management and identity security solutions that overlap with the secrets management capabilities of 1Password.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise credential, secrets, and access-security solutions evaluated by security and identity teams for protecting privileged access.

candidates.name: Strongbox
candidates.description: Provides a secure credential management tool for macOS and iOS that utilizes industry-standard encryption protocols.
candidates.rationale: Strongbox is a password and credential manager, overlapping 1Password’s core offering for users and organizations securing account access.

candidates.name: Silverfort group
candidates.description: Secures all identities across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, addressing the broader access management challenges managed by 1Password.
candidates.rationale: Silverfort provides identity threat protection and MFA infrastructure, while 1Password primarily manages credentials and workforce access; they are adjacent, not substitutes.

candidates.name: BeyondTrust
candidates.description: Focuses on identity and access security with a core competency in managing privileged access across enterprise infrastructures.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise credential and access-security solutions, including privileged access management, for security and IT teams.

candidates.name: Auth0
candidates.description: Provides a scalable identity management and authentication platform for enterprises that need to secure user and machine access.
candidates.rationale: Auth0 provides customer identity and application authentication, while 1Password primarily manages workforce credentials and passwords; their core use cases differ.

candidates.name: Ping Identity
candidates.description: Specializes in enterprise identity security, authentication, and access management for digital interactions.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise identity and access-security products evaluated by IT and security teams for authentication and workforce access control.

candidates.name: RSA
candidates.description: Offers comprehensive identity and access management solutions focusing on authentication and security governance.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise identity and access-security products, including authentication and workforce access controls, targeting the same IT and security buyers.

candidates.name: Imprivata
candidates.description: Delivers digital identity platforms that manage access and workflows for mission-critical enterprise environments.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise identity and access-security platforms used by IT/security teams to manage employee authentication and access to systems.

candidates.name: AppViewX, Inc.
candidates.description: Governs and manages machine and AI agent identities, which intersects with the secrets management functions provided by 1Password.
candidates.rationale: AppViewX primarily manages PKI, certificates, and machine identities, while 1Password focuses on workforce passwords, credentials, and access security.

candidates.name: Specops Software
candidates.description: Focuses on improving authentication security and password policy management for organizations using Active Directory.
candidates.rationale: Both provide enterprise password and authentication security tools purchased by IT/security teams to strengthen organizational access controls.

candidates.name: HashiCorp
candidates.description: Provides secrets management infrastructure and automation for developers that serves as a high-end alternative to credential management tools.
candidates.rationale: Both provide business credential and secrets management, serving developer and security teams securing access to applications and infrastructure.
